title: dev-workflow project file
description: Facts about one project, in .claude/dev-workflow.json. Its presence turns the dev-workflow hooks on. The setup skill writes it, and generates .githooks/dev-workflow.env from it: after editing it, run the setup skill again. scripts/setup/project-file.sh validate checks a file against this schema, using only these keywords: type, const, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minLength, pattern, not and allOf. Where a part has x-error, that is the message shown when it fails.
x-error: has to be one JSON object

schemaVersion.description: The version of this file's layout. Setup sets it.

pluginVersion.description: The version of the plugin that last ran setup here. Setup sets it.
pluginVersion.x-error: has to be a version, such as 1.0.0

stack.description: The stack files that apply, by name, such as node-tooling. When setup runs, each stack's database reset commands are copied into databaseResetCommands.

items.x-error: has to be a stack name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes

hasScreens.description: Whether the project has screens people use.

defaultBranch.description: The default branch, which pushes are kept off. Missing means main.
defaultBranch.x-error: has to be a branch name

commands.description: The project's commands. Only check is required.

check.description: The fast checks the pre-push hook runs, such as npm run check. Every project needs one.
check.x-error: has to be the command that runs the fast checks, such as npm run check

verify.description: The full checks, before a release.

formatCheckStaged.description: The formatting checks the pre-commit hook runs on staged files, one rule per glob, so a mixed repo can have several. Each command gets the matching files as arguments and must only check them, exiting non-zero when one isn't formatted: a command that rewrites files, with --write, -w or --fix, is refused. A glob is a shell case pattern, where * also matches /: brace globs such as *.{ts,tsx} don't expand, so write one rule for *.ts and one for *.tsx.

glob.description: The files the command checks, such as *.ts.

allOf.x-error: has to be a glob such as *.ts, without | or a line break, which separate the rules in dev-workflow.env
has braces, which the hook's case pattern doesn't expand: write one rule per glob, such as *.ts and *.tsx

command.description: The check, such as npx prettier --check.

allOf.x-error: has to be a command on one line
rewrites files: a formatter here must check, not rewrite, such as prettier --check or gofmt -l

testCommands.description: Commands that run tests, which the hooks treat as the project's own.

databaseResetCommands.description: Commands that wipe a database, which the hooks hold for a person's yes. Setup adds each stack's list from plugins/dev-workflow/stacks/<stack>.resets, when that file exists: one command per line, with blank lines and lines starting with # left out.

ciAllowlist.description: Workflows allowed per-PR triggers, by path from the repo's root. CI otherwise runs only for releases.

items.x-error: has to be a workflow's path, such as .github/workflows/release.yml

managed.description: The ledger: a fingerprint of each thing setup wrote, by path, so a rerun can tell what the project edited. Setup keeps it.
